_instructions: Fill in all fields below with real resume data. Remove any field you don't have data for (leave it as an empty string or empty array). Dates must be in YYYY-MM-DD format. The 'keyAchievements' field in both workExperience and projects must be a single string with each bullet point separated by a newline character (\n). Do NOT add any extra keys. When done, load this file into ZenCV using the 'Load Backup' button.
name: FULL NAME IN UPPERCASE
position: Your Target Job Title (e.g. Automation Test Engineer)
